gap: BAR 4 FAIL, competitor boundary, on P4's own files. The campaign rollup that P4 keeps inside the Clients destination (kairos_api/campaigns_read.py::_build_campaigns, rendered by tv-break-dashboard/src/clients/CampaignRollupPanel.jsx) groups the whole spots frame with no operator-channel filter, while the money board two panels above it on the same screen is correctly scoped to settings.operator_channel. Measured on the live API at http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/campaigns: 32 of the 50 rendered rows carry channels > 1, and the column is rendered to the operator as a count under the header 'ערוצים' (screenshot: 2024-11 מחסני חשמל Black Friday 24 shows 709 spots over 2 channels, 2024-11 עולם הקולנוע shows 443 over 3). data/Spots.csv holds 50,386 rows on four channels, of which 31,717 are not רשת 13 (כאן 11, קשת 12, עכשיו 14); restricted to the 50 campaigns this panel ranks, 10,700 of 19,495 rows, 54.9 percent, aired on a channel the operator does not own, so the rendered 'ספוטים', 'דקות', 'ערוצים' and 'שידור אחרון' are rival-channel figures on an operator surface. The repository already states the doctrine that forbids this at kairos_api/core.py:460-476, in the summary function's own docstring, and campaigns_read.py never applies it. Fix in one pass: filter the frame to settings.operator_channel before the groupby, print the scope on the panel the way the money board prints its basis line, and drop or restate the channels column, which cannot mean anything once the frame is one channel. Three smaller findings behind it, none of them the blocker. (1) A surcharge discount percent saves with an empty weekday scope: measured, deselecting every weekday chip and submitting stored surcharge_discount_percent 12.0 with surcharge_weekdays empty on CMP_006, a term that scopes nothing and was accepted silently. (2) The rollup's 'מפרסם' column is blank on 50 of 50 rows with no stated reason, next to a revenue column whose dash does carry its reason. (3) The rollup is the only dead end in a destination where everything else opens: its campaign names open nothing, while the money board's names open campaigns and spots. Everything else measured green, see P4-critic.json.
